description: Fix ``--exclude`` and ``--include`` filters given as absolute paths so they also apply to the destination side of ``sync``. Previously the destination copy of an absolute pattern could never match, so ``sync`` uploaded already synced files on every run and ``sync --delete`` removed objects an absolute ``--exclude`` was meant to protect (`issue 8932 <https://github.com/aws/aws-cli/issues/8932>`__).
